title: EntityVisibility
description: A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that adds an in-game menu where you can toggle the visibility of every entity type in the game - mobs, animals, armor stands, item frames, display entities, dropped items, projectiles, even modded entities.
body:
A lightweight client-side Fabric mod that adds an in-game menu where you can toggle the visibility of every entity type in the game (by clicking J) - mobs, animals, armor stands, item frames, display entities, dropped items, projectiles, even modded entities.

Features

- In-game menu listing every entity type
- Real-time search by name or registry ID
- One-click Visible / Hidden toggle per entity
- Bulk actions: Show all, Hide all, Invert
- Persistent settings (saved between sessions)
- Configurable keybind (default: J)
